items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 54:1
items.html: (To the question) For it is impossible for the Nukva to serve with ZA in a single Keter, except at the time when Malchut is revealed in RADLA, in the secret of the cornerstone, as above in Answer 7. This is the aspect of the end of correction, when death will be swallowed up forever. And it is found that if it had been so in the First Temple, surely no nation or tongue would have ruled over it, for after the end of correction the Klipot are nullified forever. (Item 38).
